name: pocket-chat
description: ChatGPT-style iOS chat app: Expo + FastAPI monorepo with a mock LLM provider

scripts.api:dev: cd apps/api && LLM_PROVIDER=mock uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.api:lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd apps/api && uv run ruff format .
scripts.api:typecheck: cd apps/api && uv run mypy --strict app
scripts.openapi: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.export_openapi ../../packages/shared/openapi.json
